message.content:
I don’t have the ability to make live calls to external services from here, but I can walk you through exactly how you would use the Google Maps Geocoding API (or a similar service) to turn those latitude/longitude values into a human‑readable address.

---

### 1. Build the request URL

For Google’s Geocoding API the endpoint looks like this:

```
https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng={LAT},{LNG}&key={YOUR_API_KEY}
```

Plugging in your numbers:

```
https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

> **Tip:** Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with a valid key that has “Geocoding API” enabled in the Google Cloud Console.

---

### 2. What you’ll receive

A successful response will look something like this (truncated for brevity):

```json
{
   "results" : [
      {
         "address_components" : [
            { "long_name":"1600", "short_name":"1600", "types":["street_number"] },
            { "long_name":"Amphitheatre Parkway", "short_name":"Amphitheatre Pkwy", "types":["route"] },
            { "long_name":"Mountain View", "short_name":"Mountain View", "types":["locality","political"] },
            { "long_name":"Santa Clara County", "short_name":"Santa Clara County", "types":["administrative_area_level_2","political"] },
            { "long_name":"California", "short_name":"CA", "types":["administrative_area_level_1","political"] },
            { "long_name":"United States", "short_name":"US", "types":["country","political"] },
            { "long_name":"94043", "short_name":"94043", "types":["postal_code"] }
         ],
         "formatted_address" : "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA",
         "geometry" : {
            "location" : { "lat":37.4224764, "lng":-122.0842499 },
            "location_type" : "ROOFTOP",
            "viewport" : { ... }
         },
         "place_id" : "ChIJj61dQgK6j4AR4J7x5Z8YfXU",
         "types" : ["street_address"]
      }
   ],
   "status" : "OK"
}
```

So the coordinates you supplied point to the Googleplex at 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA.

---

### 3. Quick test in your browser

If you paste the full URL (with a real API key) into a browser or curl command, you’ll see the same JSON structure. For example:

```bash
curl "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY"
```

---

### 4. Using the data

From the JSON you can extract:

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `formatted_address` | Human‑readable street address |
| `place_id` | Unique identifier for the place |
| `geometry.location.lat/lng` | Same lat/lng you queried (rounded) |
| `address_components` | Breakdown into street number, route, locality, etc. |

---

#### Bottom line

Your coordinates (`37.4224764`, `-122.0842499`) resolve to the Google headquarters. If you want to programmatically retrieve that information, just hit the Geocoding API endpoint shown above with a valid key.
